snippet.title: Town Of Tinysville - ALPHA - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
this game is peak

//PLAY TOWN OF TINYSVILLE\\
➤ https://7sevenstudios.itch.io/tinysville

//CHECK OUT MY TWITTER\\
➤  https://x.com/7Seven_Studios

//Video Background
This is a trailer for a new video game I'm working on, that I'm going to release on Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch in the future. It's a strategy deck building card game where you place down buildings in your town to get more coins. After each round, you buy new cards to add to your deck and try to build the wealthiest town possible in a small grid.

//PC SPECS:
3080 ti
ryzen 7 3700x
32gb ram
logitech g502 lightspeed mouse
logitech g613 keyboard
